title: After a rate limit (429) the next /help the person types is sent instead of sitting on Waiting; the start screen's Help dock follows the newest row
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/help.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of the case named: "after a 429 the queue is held, and the next question the person types lifts the hold and is sent".
S3 (stand, optional): on a full stack with tasks/bang-chung/lan-2-sau-merge-966/rest.mjs, cases H5-08b and H-DOCK-SCROLL.
expect: The named case is 'ok'. On the unfixed code (packages/ui/tracy-assistant/src/client/help.ts at c3ee004f4) it is 'not ok': after a 429 on question one, question two is never posted and stays queued. With the fix, question two is posted (a second POST /api/assistant/turns with message 'two') and finishes as done.

S3: after the day-limit message a NEW question is answered by the model (it used to sit on Waiting for ever); with five Help rows on the start screen the dock scrolls and the newest answer ends inside it.
evidence: Found 07/10/2026 by re-verifying #966 on images built from its merge commit: tasks/bang-chung/lan-2-sau-merge-966/KET-QUA.md (cases H5-11, H5-17 stayed red behind the stuck queue until the hold was lifted).
fence: The queue is lifted by the person's next question and the server's 429 still applies: a limit that stands is shown again on the new row, never bypassed.

tests: after a 429 the queue is held, and the next question the person types lifts the hold and is sent
